full_name: Abigail Friedman | Radcliffe Institute for Advanced Study at Harvard University
title: 2013–2014 Radcliffe Institute Graduate Student Fellow Harvard University
bio: Abigail Friedman is a PhD candidate in the economics concentration of the Harvard PhD Program in Health Policy. Her research applies behavioral and health economics to better understand the health behaviors and health-related decision making of individual consumers.
